items.title: ConocoPhillips (COP) Stock Looks Like A Bargain After Fresh Results
items.summary: ConocoPhillips has delivered a powerful run in recent years, and with earnings in focus after fresh results and a higher dividend, the key question is whether the current share price still lines up with what the business is earning. Over the past 5 years the stock has gained 127.4%, which puts real pressure on the idea that its earnings can comfortably carry today's valuation.
